passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I like to travel, and I go on a short trip.
phrases.ko: 나는 여행하는 것을 좋아하고, 짧은 여행을 가요.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢旅行，我会去一次短短的旅行。
phrases.py: wǒ xǐ huān lǚ xíng， wǒ huì qù yī cì duǎn duǎn de lǚ xíng。

phrases.en: I look at a map before we go.
phrases.py: chū fā qián wǒ kàn dì tú。

phrases.en: I see a new place, and I take a photo.
phrases.ko: 나는 새로운 장소를 보고, 사진을 찍어요.
phrases.zh: 我看见一个新地方，还拍照片。
phrases.py: wǒ kàn jiàn yí gè xīn dì fāng， hái pāi zhào piān。

phrases.en: I feel excited, and travel is fun.
phrases.zh: 我感到兴奋，旅行很有趣。
phrases.py: wǒ gǎn dào xīng fèn， lǚ xíng hěn yǒu qù。

phrases.en: My family likes a short trip on the weekend.
phrases.ko: 우리 가족은 주말의 짧은 여행을 좋아해요.
phrases.zh: 我们家人喜欢周末的短途旅行。
phrases.py: wǒ men jiā rén xǐ huān zhōu mò de duǎn tú lǚ xíng。

phrases.en: The map shows the new place.
phrases.py: dì tú shàng yǒu nà ge xīn dì fāng。

phrases.en: I see rivers, parks, and small towns.
phrases.ko: 나는 강, 공원, 작은 마을을 봐요.
phrases.zh: 我看见河、公园和小镇子。
phrases.py: wǒ kàn jiàn hé、 gōng yuán hé xiǎo zhèn zi。

phrases.en: A photo helps me remember the trip.
phrases.zh: 照片帮助我记住这次旅行。
phrases.py: zhào piān bāng zhù wǒ jì zhù zhè cì lǚ xíng。

phrases.en: I feel excited when the train starts.
phrases.zh: 火车开动的时候，我感到兴奋。
phrases.py: huǒ chē kāi dòng de shí hòu， wǒ gǎn dào xīng fèn。

phrases.en: Travel is fun because every place is a little new.
phrases.ko: 모든 장소가 조금 새로워서 여행은 재미있어요.
phrases.zh: 每个地方都有一点新，所以旅行很有趣。
phrases.py: měi gè dì fāng dōu yǒu yì diǎn xīn， suǒ yǐ lǚ xíng hěn yǒu qù。

full_passage_spoken: I like to travel, and I go on a short trip. I look at a map before we go. We ride a train. I see a new place, and I take a photo. I feel excited, and travel is fun. My family likes a short trip on the weekend. The map shows the new place. I see rivers, parks, and small towns. A photo helps me remember the trip. I feel excited when the train starts. Travel is fun because every place is a little new.
full_passage_zh: 我喜欢旅行，我会去一次短短的旅行。出发前我看地图。我们坐火车。我看见一个新地方，还拍照片。我感到兴奋，旅行很有趣。我们家人喜欢周末的短途旅行。地图上有那个新地方。我看见河、公园和小镇子。照片帮助我记住这次旅行。火车开动的时候，我感到兴奋。每个地方都有一点新，所以旅行很有趣。
